description: Implementation of the e2_setup_procedure class handling E2 setup request/response, retries, and result creation in a 3GPP network context.

classes.name: e2_setup_procedure
classes.description: Handles the E2 setup procedure including sending requests, handling responses, retries, and generating results.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main coroutine handling the E2 setup process, including retries and waiting.

methods.name: send_e2_setup_request
methods.description: Constructs and sends an E2 setup request message.

methods.name: retry_required
methods.description: Determines if the setup procedure should be retried based on transaction response and retry count.

methods.name: create_e2_setup_result
methods.description: Creates and returns the result message indicating success or failure of the setup.
